{ww | w in {a,b}*} -- a repeated-WORD pattern (w then w again), not exponent/block notation over letters.
{a^(2^n) | n>=0} -- nested exponent (2^n as an exponent's own exponent); exponent_pattern's arithmetic grammar has no '^' operator.
{w in {a,b}* | #a(w) = 2*#b(w)} -- a symbol-count predicate over an unconstrained string, not expressible as letter/word exponent blocks.
{w c reverse(w) | w in {a,b}*} -- a reverse-pattern set_builder (needs a `variables` IR with a 'w^R' word pattern, like task_wvaavRwR.json, not exponent notation).
{w reverse(w) | w in {a,b}*} -- same reverse-pattern gap as dcfl-02.
task_anb_cnbn.json's word_pattern mixes Kleene star and alternation with exponents ('a^n b* (c^n|b^n) a c*') -- outside exponent_pattern's block grammar.
'{$ a^n b^n c^m} union {d a^m b^n c^n}, n,m >= 1' -- the domain declaration trails OUTSIDE both union braces, so neither branch parses as a self-contained group.
{w in {a,b}* | w != x x for every decomposition w = x x} -- a universally-quantified 'for every decomposition' condition, not a single block/exponent pattern.
